produced_by.tool: hand-written (Forge Tech Lead, for Finnian Bond)
produced_by.potential_or_method: hand estimate: the design assumptions of Alpha-1 v1.1, not a materials calculation or a measurement

Q_dielectric.reason: Hand estimate. The chip-wide dielectric Q that Alpha-1 and Alpha-1 v1.1 already assume (designs/alpha1/ALPHA-1.md, designs/alpha1-v11/ALPHA-1-v1.1.md: 'dielectric Q = 3e6'). It is not computed, not measured and not taken from a cited source; replace it when a measured or DFT-derived value exists.

loss_tangent.relation: If the uniform-loss model in device.hpp holds, Q_dielectric = 1 / loss_tangent.
loss_tangent.reason: Not estimated separately: Q_dielectric is given, and a Q_dielectric with a value always wins.

junction_gap_ueV.reason: Hand estimate. The Al/AlOx junction gap that Alpha-1 assumes (designs/alpha1/ALPHA-1.md: 'gap 180 ueV'; also the device.hpp default). Not computed, not measured and not taken from a cited source here.

not_in_contract.Rn_spread_pct: Process spread used by fab_monte_carlo(); not an atomistic output.
not_in_contract.environment: T_eff_mK, flux_noise_uPhi0, charge_noise_e, Tphi_other_us stay in chip JSON.

notes: Decision D5 (Finnian Bond, 2026-11-28): the first sidecar with values is hand-written, so the whole path (reader, provenance checks, materials apply --out) is exercised now; the DFT bridge writes sidecars later.

Every number here equals what designs/alpha1-v11/alpha1_v11.json already holds, so applying this sidecar changes no qpuforge result. It records where the numbers come from: an assumption, provenance 'assumed'.
conditions are the Alpha-1 v1.1 operating point (T_eff 45 mK, qubit band near 5.8 GHz) and are not interpreted by the reader.
